label: Monomachine OS
description: Monomodule runs your own Monomachine OS 1.32B file (a free download from Elektron). One copy here serves Monomodule One and Monomodule FX.
hint: After adding it, load Monomodule One once and restart MPC: it makes its skin from that file.

label: Your sounds (optional)
description: Monomachine kit dumps (.syx). Their synth sounds appear as presets.

rules.label: Kit dump
rules.note: An Elektron SysEx file. Its sounds appear if it holds Monomachine kits.
